Evidence Hunt

A quiet investigator's notebook. Walk a dark floor plan, pack a few pieces of equipment, take readings and work out which spirit is in the house. Nothing is timed, nobody is harmed, and a wrong name only costs a point. A fiction game.

Cases

A chapter opens once five cases of the one before are done. Inside a chapter, take any case in any order. The seal on a case is the best you have earned there.

Achievements

Every one can be earned in any order, with no luck involved, and each shows how close you are.

    Practice houses

    A practice house is made from a short code, and the same code always makes the same house. Pick a size, or type a code someone gave you. Practice never changes a seal, but every reading and every guide page it fills still counts.
